description: Open or resume the study page for an exam, optionally focused on a domain or a sub-objective. Use this when someone asks to study rather than to be quizzed in chat: the page gives them a visible question they answer themselves, and once it is open a richer set of tools appears for reading and steering that screen. Returns the URL; a browser agent should navigate there.

sub_objective.description: Optional concept, e.g. "d1.5". Ids are per-exam.

name: open_study
title: Open a study session
